attrs.doc:
!!! abstract "Usage Documentation"
    [Fields](../concepts/fields.md)

Create a field for objects that can be configured.

Used to provide extra information about a field, either for the model schema or complex validation. Some arguments
apply only to number fields (`int`, `float`, `Decimal`) and some apply only to `str`.

Note:
    - Any `_Unset` objects will be replaced by the corresponding value defined in the `_DefaultValues` dictionary. If a key for the `_Unset` object is not found in the `_DefaultValues` dictionary, it will default to `None`

Args:
    default: Default value if the field is not set.
    default_factory: A callable to generate the default value. The callable can either take 0 arguments
        (in which case it is called as is) or a single argument containing the already validated data.
    alias: The name to use for the attribute when validating or serializing by alias.
        This is often used for things like converting between snake and camel case.
    alias_priority: Priority of the alias. This affects whether an alias generator is used.
    validation_alias: Like `alias`, but only affects validation, not serialization.
    serialization_alias: Like `alias`, but only affects serialization, not validation.
    title: Human-readable title.
    field_title_generator: A callable that takes a field name and returns title for it.
    description: Human-readable description.
    examples: Example values for this field.
    exclude: Whether to exclude the field from the model serialization.
    exclude_if: A callable that determines whether to exclude a field during serialization based on its value.
    discriminator: Field name or Discriminator for discriminating the type in a tagged union.
    deprecated: A deprecation message, an instance of `warnings.deprecated` or the `typing_extensions.deprecated` backport,
        or a boolean. If `True`, a default deprecation message will be emitted when accessing the field.
    json_schema_extra: A dict or callable to provide extra JSON schema properties.
    frozen: Whether the field is frozen. If true, attempts to change the value on an instance will raise an error.
    validate_default: If `True`, apply validation to the default value every time you create an instance.
        Otherwise, for performance reasons, the default value of the field is trusted and not validated.
    repr: A boolean indicating whether to include the field in the `__repr__` output.
    init: Whether the field should be included in the constructor of the dataclass.
        (Only applies to dataclasses.)
    init_var: Whether the field should _only_ be included in the constructor of the dataclass.
        (Only applies to dataclasses.)
    kw_only: Whether the field should be a keyword-only argument in the constructor of the dataclass.
        (Only applies to dataclasses.)
    coerce_numbers_to_str: Whether to enable coercion of any `Number` type to `str` (not applicable in `strict` mode).
    strict: If `True`, strict validation is applied to the field.
        See [Strict Mode](../concepts/strict_mode.md) for details.
    gt: Greater than. If set, value must be greater than this. Only applicable to numbers.
    ge: Greater than or equal. If set, value must be greater than or equal to this. Only applicable to numbers.
    lt: Less than. If set, value must be less than this. Only applicable to numbers.
    le: Less than or equal. If set, value must be less than or equal to this. Only applicable to numbers.
    multiple_of: Value must be a multiple of this. Only applicable to numbers.
    min_length: Minimum length for iterables.
    max_length: Maximum length for iterables.
    pattern: Pattern for strings (a regular expression).
    allow_inf_nan: Allow `inf`, `-inf`, `nan`. Only applicable to float and [`Decimal`][decimal.Decimal] numbers.
    max_digits: Maximum number of allow digits for strings.
    decimal_places: Maximum number of decimal places allowed for numbers.
    union_mode: The strategy to apply when validating a union. Can be `smart` (the default), or `left_to_right`.
        See [Union Mode](../concepts/unions.md#union-modes) for details.
    fail_fast: If `True`, validation will stop on the first error. If `False`, all validation errors will be collected.
        This option can be applied only to iterable types (list, tuple, set, and frozenset).
    extra: (Deprecated) Extra fields that will be included in the JSON schema.

        !!! warning Deprecated
            The `extra` kwargs is deprecated. Use `json_schema_extra` instead.

Returns:
    A new [`FieldInfo`][pydantic.fields.FieldInfo]. The return annotation is `Any` so `Field` can be used on
        type-annotated fields without causing a type error.

attrs.name: HTTPException
attrs.doc:
An HTTP exception you can raise in your own code to show errors to the client.

This is for client errors, invalid authentication, invalid data, etc. Not for server
errors in your code.

Read more about it in the
[FastAPI docs for Handling Errors](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/handling-errors/).

## Example

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

app = FastAPI()

items = {"foo": "The Foo Wrestlers"}


@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
async def read_item(item_id: str):
    if item_id not in items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    return {"item": items[item_id]}
```

An HTTP exception you can raise in your own code to show errors to the client.

A file uploaded in a request.

Define it as a *path operation function* (or dependency) parameter.

If you are using a regular `def` function, you can use the `upload_file.file`

手动「继续 / 从失败处继续 / 恢复」之前，确认上一轮的 CLI 真的不在了。

⛔ 为什么非有不可：自动续跑那条路（main.py lifespan）发现还有活着的孤儿 CLI
   时会跳过，把工作流留在暂停态 —— 可用户看到的就是一个暂停的工作流，点一下
   「继续」照样能把第二个 claude 拉起来，两个进程写同一个工作区，产物互相覆盖、
   额度花两份。自动那条路挡住了，手动这条路必须挡同样的东西。

先按**这个工作流**的名下再回收一次（严格身份核验，绝不碰别的工作流、也不碰
本进程正在跑的进程）；仍然收不掉就拒绝，并把原因原样交给前端展示。

⛔ 放进线程跑：回收要等 taskkill 确认（每个 pid 最多 10 秒），取创建时间还可能
   退到 PowerShell。直接在事件循环里跑，这几秒会把整个后端（含 WebSocket 心跳）
   一起冻住 —— 用户看到的就是「点了继续，整个界面卡住了」。

attrs.name: _assert_workspace_free
attrs.doc: 启动全自动之前调。⛔ 必须在启动锁内调，否则两个请求会在 await 间隙同时通过。

attrs.name: _attach_active_at
attrs.doc:
左栏按“最后一次动静”分组排序（10-17 用户：“项目的时间归类不太正确”）：项目这一行的改动时间和对话里最后一条
消息取晚的那个——在对话里说话不改 updated_at。只加在返回的副本上，不改库。

attrs.name: _attach_chat_runtime
attrs.doc:
给列表响应叠加协同模式的瞬时运行态，但绝不改写主工作流表。

``workflows.status`` 是全自动引擎和心跳恢复的状态源。协同任务若把它
持久化为 running，心跳会把对话任务误认成全自动流水线并重复拉起。
因此这里只在 GET 列表的返回副本上叠加 ``runtime_activity``，让首页
能如实显示“协同排队/执行中”，同时保留两套执行器的隔离。

活跃任务通常很少，直接利用 chat_messages(status) 索引读取全部活跃行，
避免首页有上千个工作流时拼出超过 SQLite 参数上限的 IN 查询。

attrs.name: _attach_progress
attrs.doc:
给列表响应叠加每个项目的进度（项目卡片上"第几步 / 共几步、现在在哪一步"）。

一次读出所有步骤的名字和状态再按项目汇总，不按项目逐个查；只读，不改主表。

attrs.name: _attach_step_labels
attrs.doc:
首页列表：当前步骤写中文名（曾直接写 survey-design 这类内部名）；市调新流程再写一句现在等团队做什么
（survey_hint：badge 换掉笼统的“已暂停”）。只改响应副本，读不到就照旧返回。

attrs.name: _build_export_zip
attrs.doc: 构建导出 zip 文件（同步，在线程池中调用）。clean=True 为参赛精简版。

attrs.name: _build_survey_submission_zip
attrs.doc:
市调大赛参赛版（同步，在线程池中调用）。一份报告文件都没有时报错，不给空包。
用模拟答卷出的练习稿（数据由程序生成）不给打包（2026-10-21）。

attrs.name: _chat_busy
attrs.doc:
对话模式是否正占着这个工作区。

⛔ 为什么不能只查 _tasks：对话执行不走 run_workflow，不注册进 _tasks。
⛔ 为什么不能只查 claude_runner.is_running(wf_id)：那是前缀匹配 `{wf_id}_`，
   而对话进程键故意是 `chat-{wf_id}-{run_id}`（不带主 wf_id 前缀，
   否则 cancel(wf_id) 会顺手杀掉对话任务）→ 前缀匹配查不到它。
   所以必须问队列自己。

attrs.name: _cleanup_workspace
attrs.doc: 后台异步删除工作区目录，不阻塞主流程

attrs.name: _conversation_running_guard
attrs.doc:
A5：对话模式的项目在跑步骤时，"重新运行 / 重跑这一步"不能直接把它取消（已花的额度作废，
对话里的运行块也对不上）。从对话页"项目详情"进来点到的就是这两个按钮：先在对话里停下，或等它跑完。
⛔ 必须在取消正在跑的 task 之前调。全自动项目保持原来的"取消并重来"。

attrs.name: _do_delete
attrs.doc: 删除工作流：先删数据库（立刻生效），再后台异步删文件

attrs.name: _extract_import_workspace
attrs.doc:
把一个工作流的 workspace/ 成员流式解压进 new_ws，返回 (文件数, 跳过的成员, 其中危险的成员)。

在线程里跑，不卡事件循环。budget 是整次导入共用的 {"bytes", "files"} 计数：和上传解压
（services/archive_import）同一套上限。以前这条路不限解压总量（1 KB 能解出 1 MB 的全零成员，
2 GB 的包就能写满磁盘），可执行文件和脚本（.exe/.ps1/.lnk…）也照样落进工作区。

attrs.name: _get_start_lock
attrs.doc: 获取（或懒创建）某工作流的启动锁。同一 wf_id 始终返回同一把锁。

attrs.name: _heartbeat_check
attrs.doc: 定期检查：如果数据库里工作流是 running 但没有对应的 task，自动修复。

attrs.name: _is_problem_source
attrs.doc:
user_data 里的赛题原文（评委已有、非提交物）：赛题 PDF、提取文本、A/B/C 题文档。
仅对 user_data/ 下的文件判定。

attrs.name: _mark_unexpected_task_exit
attrs.doc:
Turn a task that returned without a terminal DB state into a diagnosis.

A rare exception can happen outside ``run_workflow``'s internal try block
(decorator binding, cancellation during startup, or a backend hot-reload).
Previously that left ``workflows.status='running'`` with no task; the
heartbeat then entered the whole authorization-preparation path again every
minute.  Marking the row failed is safer than silently replaying a paid or
file-mutating step.  Normal completed/paused/failed tasks are untouched.

attrs.name: _register_workflow_task
attrs.doc: Register a workflow task and guard the task→DB lifecycle boundary.

attrs.name: _reset_interrupted_steps
attrs.doc:
Retry unfinished work, never infer success from a later completed step.

Preserve an interrupted running step's start marker so the engine can
inspect its own artifacts before deciding whether another model call is
necessary. A failed step must pass its normal repair/acceptance path.
Successful and checkpoint-waiting steps are not rewritten. The caller
owns the transaction and per-workflow launch lock.

attrs.name: _revalidate_failed_paper_writer
attrs.doc:
Recognise a stale, modeling-gate-only writer failure without an AI call.

This is intentionally narrow.  It never promotes compilation failures,
missing/undersized artifacts, submission-contract failures, or a failure
that still reproduces under the current deterministic gate.  The purpose
is to avoid replaying an expensive paper-writing step after a gate bug has
been fixed while leaving every other recovery path unchanged.

attrs.name: _should_include_file
attrs.doc: 判断文件是否应该包含在导出 zip 中。

attrs.name: _should_include_file_clean
attrs.doc: 精简导出：白名单式判断。先过通用规则（跳隐藏/缓存/日志等），再只放白名单顶层。

attrs.name: _stage_cli_resume_choice
attrs.doc: Persist one explicit resume choice on the current unfinished step.

attrs.name: _stop_conversation_runtime
attrs.doc:
删工作流前，停掉不归全自动任务槽管的执行：协同队列与任务进程、主会话、编辑器任务。

claude_runner.cancel(wf_id) 只认 `{wf_id}` 与 `{wf_id}_*`；协同任务的进程键是
`chat-{wf_id}-{run}`、编辑器是 `editor_{wf_id}`（故意分开，停全自动时才不会误杀），
所以要逐个停。⛔ 每一步失败只记日志：删除本身不能被它们挡住。

attrs.name: _strip_bootstrap
attrs.doc: 从 py 源码剔除引擎注入的自举头块（幂等；无标记则原样返回）。

attrs.name: _survey_rerun_guard
attrs.doc:
市调新流程：团队做过决定（选定题目、问卷定稿、确认数据）之后，整条“重新运行”和会改写问卷/研究设计的单步重跑
后端直接拒绝（曾只靠界面，“重新运行”一点就把前几步重新付费、改写定稿问卷）。⛔ 必须在取消正在跑的 task 之前调：
被拒的请求不能顺手把正在跑的步骤停掉。

attrs.name: _survey_start_guard
attrs.doc:
市调“问卷和数据都有”：导入清洗还没做完时，点“开始/继续”先看一眼上传的问卷和答卷（只读文件，不调用模型）。
缺问卷、缺答卷、答卷全都用不了时直接说清楚、不开跑——曾照样开跑，付费跑完研究设计和问卷整理两步才在导入前停下。

attrs.name: _try_continue_columns
attrs.doc:
第一档 B2 新增的三列（交接原因 / 主产物回执 / 付费继续次数），以及对话模式的 run_scope。

生产库启动时已迁移；只有未迁移的旧表结构（测试夹具）会缺列，那时静默跳过。

attrs.name: check_paper_modeling_quality
attrs.doc:
数模论文的建模深度对照（目标/约束/公式保真）。

统计建模只要求“自圆其说”，这套“算对类”检查不跑：如实返回“不适用（统计建模）”，
不写“通过”。其他赛事行为不变。

attrs.name: claim_auto_resume
attrs.doc:
Atomically claim one automatic workflow restart.

The caller must use a fresh connection.  ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` serializes
heartbeat/startup workers even when a stale deployment accidentally leaves
two backend processes pointing at the same SQLite database.  Only a worker
that successfully increments the durable counter may create a new task.
``allow_paused`` is reserved for the startup snapshot produced by
``init_db``; a normal heartbeat may only claim a currently-running row.

attrs.name: clean_custom_name
attrs.doc: 用户起的项目名：去掉控制字符、合并空白、最长 CUSTOM_NAME_MAX 个字；空的返回 None（= 没另起名，显示题目）。

attrs.name: clear_pause_request
attrs.doc:
清除暂停标记。⛔ 所有启动路径（start/resume/restart/rerun/心跳复活/重启恢复/
检查点续跑）都必须调用，否则工作流会在下一步立刻自杀、再也起不来。

attrs.name: create_new_workflow
attrs.doc:
建项目。workflow_id 给了就是把首页对话建的草稿定型（services/project_intake.confirm）：
在同一个项目号、同一个工作区上补齐参数、CLAUDE.md 和步骤，对话记录不用搬家；
before_commit(db) 在同一个事务里、提交之前调用（草稿那边借它写赛题标记、记"已定型"）。
attrs.sig: (template: 'str', title: 'str', params: 'dict', enable_checkpoints: 'bool' = False, *, workflow_id: 'str | None' = None, before_commit=None) -> 'str'

attrs.name: datetime
attrs.doc:
datetime(year, month, day[, hour[, minute[, second[, microsecond[,tzinfo]]]]])

The year, month and day arguments are required. tzinfo may be None, or an
instance of a tzinfo subclass. The remaining arguments may be ints.

attrs.name: export_batch
attrs.doc: 批量导出多个工作流为单个 zip。

attrs.name: export_one
attrs.doc:
导出单个工作流为 zip。
mode=full（默认）：全量导出（DB 元数据 + 全部工作区文件），行为同旧版。
mode=clean：参赛精简版（只 paper/code/figures/结果，剔工具产物与自举头 + README）。

attrs.name: export_workflow_data
attrs.doc: 导出工作流的完整 DB 数据（workflow + steps + logs），返回 dict 或 None。

attrs.name: get_logs
attrs.doc: 从数据库读取历史日志（WebSocket 断开后的兜底）

attrs.name: import_workflow_data
attrs.doc: 从导出的 manifest 数据导入工作流到 DB。

attrs.name: import_workflows
attrs.doc: 从 zip 文件导入工作流。支持单个和批量导出的 zip。

attrs.name: inspect_template
attrs.doc:
新建页“格式模板”预检（建任务之前）：认主文件、编译方式、栏数，试编译一次，告诉用户缺什么。

文件只在临时目录里过一遍就删，不进任何工作区；认不出唯一主文件时返回候选，由用户在页面上选（不猜），
选好后带 ``main`` 再调一次。``prefer=word`` 时优先认 Word 模板（Word 输出）。不调用模型。
attrs.sig: (files: 'Annotated[list[UploadFile], File(...)]', main: 'Annotated[Optional[str], Form()]' = None, prefer: 'Annotated[Optional[str], Form()]' = None) -> 'dict'

attrs.name: is_private_part
attrs.doc:
Is this ONE path component a protected/control name?

``depth``: where the component sits (0 = project root).  Unknown (None) keeps the
conservative rule; below the root, ``skills`` / ``capsules`` are ordinary user folders.

Every filter that used to write ``part.casefold() in PRIVATE_PARTS`` must
call this instead, otherwise a suffix rule added here silently applies on
some paths and not on others -- which is how a private name ends up
readable through one route and blocked on another.

attrs.name: is_rebuildable_part
attrs.doc: Is this component Modex-owned runtime / a cache we simply rebuild?

attrs.name: project_cover
attrs.doc: 项目卡片的封面缩略图（PNG）：论文 PDF 第一页，没有论文就用最新的一张图；都没有回 404，前端显示类型字标。

attrs.name: public_artifact_path
attrs.doc:
Authorize public reads AND writes, including not-yet-created files.

This is an HTTP/application boundary, not isolation from a local process
able to mutate the workspace concurrently. Internal tools use their own
explicitly scoped access; UI filters must never replace this check.

``exempt_parts`` waives the private-name rule for the listed components
ONLY -- every other component is still judged, and traversal, symlink and
Windows-name checks are never waived.  The single caller is the workflow
importer, with ``EXPORT_EXEMPT_PARTS``; do not widen it without saying why
the name cannot make a local tool execute something.

attrs.name: redo_applies
attrs.doc: 真做完过的步骤（不是用户跳过的伪完成，口径同 run_workflow 里的 _is_user_skip）：重跑它按“重做”处理。

attrs.name: redo_mark
attrs.doc: 写进交接原因的重做记号；why 只给人看（日志、排查），不交给模型。

attrs.name: rename_workflow
attrs.doc:
给项目起个自己的名字（10-20 内测反馈“希望能给任务增加自命名环节，以免任务多以后不方便找”）。

只改显示用的 custom_name：title 仍是研究方向 / 题目（写进 CLAUDE.md、每一步按它做），不跟着改。
空的 = 不另起名，照旧显示题目。草稿也是项目表里的一行，同一个接口。不改 updated_at：改名不算项目有进展，左栏顺序不跳。

attrs.name: request_pause
attrs.doc: 标记用户要求暂停。pause 接口调用，步骤循环每步开头检查。

attrs.name: rerun_step
attrs.doc: 重新执行工作流中的单个步骤。

attrs.name: reset_auto_resume_state
attrs.doc:
Reset durable automatic-recovery guard after an explicit user action.

This is deliberately a separate helper so callers can keep the reset in
the same transaction that stages ``status='running'``.  If an older test
fixture has no migration columns, leave its behavior unchanged; production
databases are migrated by :func:`init_db` before any workflow can start.

attrs.name: restart
attrs.doc: 完全重置工作流，重新从头执行所有步骤。

attrs.name: router
attrs.doc:
`APIRouter` class, used to group *path operations*, for example to structure
an app in multiple files. It would then be included in the `FastAPI` app, or
in another `APIRouter` (ultimately included in the app).

Read more about it in the
[FastAPI docs for Bigger Applications - Multiple Files](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/bigger-applications/).

## Example

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI

app = FastAPI()
router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/users/", tags=["users"])
async def read_users():
    return [{"username": "Rick"}, {"username": "Morty"}]


app.include_router(router)
```

attrs.doc: Save a server-listed account model without restarting or spending credits.

attrs.name: set_step_effort
attrs.doc:
修改工作流某步骤的思考强度（写 params.step_efforts），可选自动重跑本步。

body: { effort: str（low/medium/high/xhigh/max；空串=删除该步覆盖，回退全局）, rerun: bool }

与 set_step_model 完全同构（同一把启动锁、同样的清键逻辑、同样的 running 自动重跑）。
⛔ 值必须过 effort.sanitize：CLI 对非法 --effort 直接报错退出，脏值落库
   会让该步骤之后每次启动都失败。非法值一律当"清除该步覆盖"处理。

attrs.name: set_step_model
attrs.doc:
修改工作流某步骤用的模型预设（写 params.step_models），可选自动重跑本步。

body: { preset_id: str（空串=删除该步覆盖，回退全局）, rerun: bool }
- 更新 params 后：pending/未跑的步骤下次跑自然生效；
- rerun=true 或该步当前 running → 复用单步重跑（取消旧进程 + run_single_step），立即换模型生效。

attrs.name: update_workflow
attrs.doc: 更新工作流字段，带重试逻辑应对并发锁竞争。

attrs.name: venue_families
attrs.doc: 新建页“投稿格式”面板用的格式清单（只读；注册表坏了时整块面板隐藏，不影响建别的工作流）。

doc:
对话建项目的参数规格：每种项目类型有哪些设置、默认值、取值范围、谁能定。

⛔ 唯一的参照物是新建表单 web/frontend/src/pages/NewWorkflow.tsx 的提交逻辑（handleSubmit
   里组装 params 的那一段，以及各项的初始值和联动）。`build()` 对同样的选择必须生成和表单
   一模一样的 template / title / params —— 由对拍测试守住：前端测试让表单真提交一遍，结果存成
   tests/data/intake_form_goldens.json，后端测试要求 build() 逐键一致。改了表单的规则，那边
   的测试先报；改了这里，这边的测试报。两边都改完才能过。

这里的"选择"（choices）就是表单上用户能动的那些状态，换成了语义名字；没给的取表单初始值。
谁能定：
  · AI 能填大部分（读完材料后填项目类型、题号、格式……），用户在设置卡上随时改；
  · 有些只能用户本人定（在对话里说、或在右栏「设置」里选），AI 自己填了不收（user_only）；
    国赛 AI 工具使用声明写论文前定就行：缺它不挡建项目（later），写论文前调度层和引擎会拦：AI 使用声明是用户的事实（K9）、
    盲评词、市调届次/组别/赛道（K11）、会多花额度的开关和模型（用户 10-11 定：默认和表单一样，
    只能用户改）；
  · 有些虽有默认值，也必须用户亲手点一次才算数（explicit）：国赛 AI 使用声明、市调三项。
学术写作的写作档案（研究类型、学科、学位层次……，论证逻辑与文理分型第 6 期）和新建页的写作档案面板同一份选项
（web/frontend/src/utils/academicProfile.ts，测试核对两边一致）；"让 AI 判断"这类默认值不提交，写作时 AI 在大纲里判断。
